independent_question_status: Qualification of original cross-editor transfer direction only; not a new contribution.
resolutions: Failure families are nonexclusive. An editor fingerprint is itself a potential new shortcut, whereas coverage failure can concern preexisting shortcuts.
Unknown animal identities and consumed data do not prohibit exploratory finite-photo-pool experiments. They constrain fresh confirmation and animal-population claims.
Primary scientific stop is absence of a concrete pre-result discriminating contrast beyond closest-work explanations; no requirement to invent a new algorithm.
A readable repository license is not silently used to certify an external data package or edited-label truth.
The existing Pets route has zero new image download cost but does not deliver natural-scene nuisance semantics or new independent animal identities.
